original_test_intent: Validate every Type 39 Device Name as the owner-defined supply identity label—not an assumed model or part number—and confirm its string reference/value remain stable after reboot.
original_method: Resolve the Device Name string index in each complete Type 39 record, bind the exact string to a stable PSU identity, compare it with the approved naming inventory and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user defines the intended naming/identity comparison and approves reboot; core validation is read-only and automated.
required_inputs: Expected Device Name per possible/installed supply and case/normalization policy
Explicit distinction among device name, model, part number and location
SMBIOS version, raw/string-table parser and read-only inventory mapping
safety_requirements: Do not manipulate a supply to prove its identity.
Validate the raw string index and exact text before any normalization.
Correlate records with stable handles/approved identifiers, not array order.
Do not auto-retry reboot; stop on power or management degradation.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve each Device Name index, preserve exact text, bind it to supply identity, apply the approved naming comparison and diff all records across reboot.
Flag dangling, empty, duplicate, semantically wrong or drifting names without declaring PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve which identity attribute Device Name must represent, its expected map and reboot plan.
Adjudicate naming exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct, but grep omits the string index, owning supply and distinction from model/part number.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive all Type 39 raw/string data and produce a handle/identity/index/exact-name/expected-name table with pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Device Name scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no physical action is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Range-check and resolve the Device Name reference for each supply, compare exact and policy-normalized forms to the approved device-name map, and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Device Name string definition plus project identity map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds string integrity, stable ownership and explicit identity semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects valid-looking names copied to the wrong record or confused with model/part number.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved Device Name semantics and mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: External inventory may expose a model rather than the firmware Device Name; compare only mappings explicitly approved by the owner.

project_override_considerations: Projects may choose naming conventions and normalization, but must retain exact raw/resolved strings and cannot silently substitute another PSU identity field.
expected_evidence: Approved Device Name semantics, mapping and duplicate/empty policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 39 handles, indices and resolved exact strings
Stable per-supply identity correlation and comparison result
Statement that no PSU was manipulated
Approved reboot/health record and complete post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Device Name is a valid Type 39 string field; its platform value is an execution baseline, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Exact string and identity mapping are automatable once the naming contract is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds string-index integrity, stable identity binding and name-versus-model semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its coverage/safety but restores FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps missing owner data in readiness rather than misclassifying the software core.

review_improvement: Stops a non-empty string from passing when it is the wrong identity attribute or belongs to another supply.
independent_technical_reasoning: Device Name is an owner-defined identity string reference; correctness requires both raw reference validity and semantic mapping to the intended supply identity.
